Full job description
About Turing:
Turing’s mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high-quality data, evaluations, and reinforcement learning environments that improve model capabilities in coding, reasoning, tool use, and multimodality. In coding, Turing is the largest and longest-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across Financial Services, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Retail, Automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end-to-end agentic AI systems inside mission-critical workflows.

Role Overview:
Worked on projects focused on fine-tuning and improving large language models such as ChatGPT. Analyzed complex content, summarized key information, validated claims through online research, and solved logical problems. Created high-quality analytical responses, detailed explanations, and training scenarios to enhance model accuracy. Developed expertise in leveraging AI to strengthen research and analytical capabilities.

Key Responsibilities:
Analyzed complex content, datasets, logical puzzles, and research-based questions.
Researched online sources to verify claims and validate information accuracy.
Summarized large volumes of content into concise and logical sections.
Evaluated AI-generated responses and provided accurate corrections with explanations.
Created analytical scenarios and annotations to improve large language model performance.

Requirements:
Can be a student or a fresher.
Demonstrated fluency in U.S. English (en-US).
Maintained an active, previously established Gemini App account with genuine conversation history (Avoid creating an account solely for participation in this project).
Maintained at least 10 separate conversations related to education, learning, academics, exam preparation, research, projects, or skill development (This will be validated before joining).
Demonstrated excellent English reading, writing, comprehension, and communication skills.
Applied strong research, analytical, logical reasoning, and problem-solving abilities.
Provided constructive feedback supported by detailed explanations and annotations.
Applied creative and lateral thinking to solve unfamiliar and complex problems.
Worked independently while maintaining productivity in a remote environment.

Preferred Skills:
Pursued or completed a bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field.
Demonstrated relevant professional experience in analysis, research, writing, editing, translation, or journalism.
Used Microsoft Excel and Google Workspace for documentation and data-related tasks.
Interpreted data and applied basic arithmetic to evaluate trends and relationships.
Applied logical reasoning and AI-assisted tools to improve research and analytical outcomes.

Project Details:
Start date - As soon as possible.
Project duration - 16 weeks.
